# Existing user post-update onboarding views (2026-01-31 16:12Z)

_**User**_

New users get the full onboarding wizard experience. Existing users who update to the new version will not see the onboarding wizard. But I want to show these Users on next launch of the app the "OnboardingWelcomeView, the OnboardingDeviceKeyView and the OnboardingDoneView" one time after the update



---

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Designing onboarding state and mode handling**

I'm planning to add an OnboardingMode enum and manage onboardingMode plus showOnboarding as published properties in AppState, initializing them based on UserDefaults and SettingsManager status. The challenge is ensuring SettingsManager registers defaults before AppState init runs, since @StateObject properties initialize before the app's init method.
**Planning AppState initialization after defaults registration**

I’m considering initializing the AppState @StateObject inside the app’s init after calling registerDefaults to ensure UserDefaults are set before AppState reads them. This involves assigning _appState in init instead of using a default property value, which is valid but a bigger code change. Alternatively, I might rely on SettingsManager defaults being effectively loaded already and verify this next by checking its implementation.</details></think>
